text:
sam (support): multiple customers hitting 502/504 from hosted inference starting ~2026-03-17T09:20Z. high-level: /v1/generate errors, latency climbs, user complaints. sample request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

ryan (oncall): seeing gateway 502 spike in Grafana too. traces show backend waits on kv-prefetch + memcached auth failures. error rate ~8% across prod-us-east.

maria (sre): digging into kv layer. memcached clients started failing auth handshakes around 09:19:50 UTC. stack traces show repeated TLS handshake remote close -> fallback to slow path -> timeouts.

maria (sre): log snippet (from edge-proxy & kv-prefetch):
```
[09:21:12] gateway: upstream error 502 memcached: AUTH failed: TLS handshake error: remote closed
[09:21:13] kv-prefetch: memcached conn reset, rc=ECONNRESET, auth=fail
[09:21:14] proxy: request timeout after 30s, route=/v1/generate model=model-redwood-v2
```

sam (support): customers report reproducible 502s when they hit ~longer prompts and chat-streaming. provided one curl example to repro:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Request-ID: rq_0a1b2c3d" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"model-redwood-v2","prompt":"...long..."}'
```

ryan (oncall): immediate mitigations proposed: 1) flip kv-prefetch circuit to open (force bypass memcached) 2) revert recent memcached client cert rotation (if that's the cause) 3) raise gateway timeout for affected routes to 60s while we stabilize. which do we want first? :thinking_face:

alex (infra): I rolled back the memcached client cert rotation at 09:24:10 UTC (rolled to last-known-good cert). also disabled aggressive reconnect in client for now. pushing config in prod-us-east.

maria (sre): thanks. enabling kv-prefetch circuit breaker now (will send traffic direct to model runtime without memcached). doing on a canary first then cluster-wide if green.

support-bot: created support ticket #SUP-8241 and linked affected customer IDs. notified CS.

ryan (oncall): after rollback + circuit open, error rate dropped to ~0.9% in 5m window. latency returning to baseline. still watching for auth retries/backoff thundering.

sam (support): passing update to customers: "we identified memcached auth handshakes failing after a cert rotation, we've rolled back and opened cache circuit. Services are recovering, please let us know if you still see 502s (include X-Request-ID)." :thumbsup:

maria (sre): next steps: 1) collect full memcached client debug logs for 09:10-09:30 window 2) hunt for race in rotation job (k8s job or key-rotation lambda) 3) add canary checks on client TLS handshake success before rotation 4) postmortem if SMT shows customer impact > 5 customers.

alex (infra): opening infra ticket INFRA-1567 to audit rotation job and add preflight check.

incidents-bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-0317-MEMCACHE-1. severity: high. Incident channel: #incidents/INC-2026-0317-MEMCACHE-1.

sam (support): closing loop here for now. will update thread when postmortem draft is ready. customers notified and CS assigned.
